messages:
nina_pm: Heads up - we need a rollout pattern for routing-fallbacks that satisfies EU data residency + a handful of high-traffic tenants that require per-tenant pinning. Goal: reduce tail latency regressions while preserving deterministic fallback semantics.

hao_eng: Suggestion: region-first deployment (eu-central -> us-west -> us-east) but with a parallel per-tenant opt-in toggle for 5 key customers. That lets us validate residency and customer SLA contracts separately.

ravi_sre: Important: allow per-tenant kill-switches scoped to tenant-id. If a tenant sees >0.3% errors or p99 delta > 20% for 3m, flip tenant-level kill. Global kill remains for platform-wide incidents.

amelie_cs: Sales/legal asked for KMS assurance in EU for Private later. For now, include a note that private deploys must use customer-managed KMS and we won't enable routing-fallbacks until keys verified.

devops: Flag design: hierarchical keys are easiest. Example:```yaml
ff.routing_fallbacks:
  enabled: true
  default_slice_pct: 2
  per_tenant:
    tenant:abc123: {enabled: true, slice_pct: 5}
  kill_switch_global: false
  kill_switch_tenant: []
```

hao_eng: Bake windows: 30m shadow + 1% for 45m + 10% for 60m. For EU start window choose 03:00-07:00 UTC to minimize business impact. During the 1% window sample full request traces (sanitized) for root-cause.

ravi_sre: Monitoring hooks: reroute_rate, fallback_invocations, prompt_truncation_rate, downstream-retry-rate. Add alert thresholds: fallback_invocations increase >150% baseline OR reroute_rate >1% absolute -> page on-call.

amelie_cs: Can we provide a one-click rollback link in the customer portal for the 5 opt-ins? Support wants that.

devops: We can expose an admin toggle but need an audit trail. Will add an immutable event in audit logs when toggles change.

nina_pm: Decision framing: 1) Region-first order (eu -> us-west -> us-east) 2) Per-tenant opt-in cohort for 5 customers with per-tenant kill-switch and portal rollback 3) Flag hierarchy and audit logs 4) Telemetry: sample traces during 1% and 10% windows 5) Legal/KMS gating for Private.

hao_eng: One open question: A/B vs canary. For UX metrics (completion tokens, helpfulness) do A/B across users in same region. For infra/latency do canary slices. Keep cohorts disjoint.

amelie_cs: Customer comms: I'll prepare a short FAQ + legal note and run by sales. Request: tag customers with expected test times 48h in advance.

ravi_sre: Rollback ladder: auto soft (slice_pct -> 0.1%) -> tenant-level kill (automated) -> global kill (manual). Add a cooldown so we don't flip-flop.

devops: ops-bot: created ticket RI-11011 for rollout automation and RI-11012 for per-tenant portal toggle. (assigned: hao_eng, ravi_sre, devops)

ops-bot: RI-11011 assigned to hao_eng; dry-run scheduled 2026-03-27T03:00:00Z.

nina_pm: Align on owner: hao -> rollout automation, ravi -> SRE gates, devops -> flag + portal, amelie -> customer comms. Please DM if conflicts. :white_check_mark:
